answer: Reputation decay resists sybils: standing is not won once and kept, it erodes each epoch unless refreshed by genuine work. A fake farm can flash like a raven taking wing, but every idle clone's weight thins like a fraying thread the moment it stops contributing and can only wander, not climb. Attackers must keep each of a thousand accounts busy forever — a one-time swarm becomes a permanent, compounding labor bill they cannot sustain.
